title: Boltz submarine swap

schema.script: SIZE 32 EQUAL IF HASH160 hash EQUALVERIFY key ELSE DROP <n> CLTV DROP key ENDIF CHECKSIG

note: The check matches SIZE, the number 32, EQUAL, IF, HASH160, a 20-byte hash, EQUALVERIFY, a compressed key, ELSE, DROP, a small delay, CLTV, DROP, a compressed key, ENDIF, CHECKSIG. Other hash-or-timelock swaps are WLS-18. Not an insert package.
